description: Rothco’s Enhanced Molded Dual Magazine Pouch is the perfect accessory for law enforcement, public safety professionals, shooting sport pros, airsoft enthusiasts, and more. Designed to securely hold 2 9MM or .45 magazines, this gun pouch ensures your magazines are insulated and easily accessible. The firearm mag pouch is constructed from durable materials and features a high-density foam center, providing years of reliable use. The soft lining inside the tactical pouch prevents damage to your magazines, while the reliable snap closures ensure they stay securely in place. The snap closure on the back fastens to duty belts up to 2 ¼ inches wide, making it compatible with most standard-sized belts. Measuring 6 inch x 5 inch, this dual magazine pouch is compact and practical, making it an essential addition to your tactical gear.
